title: Legal & Licenses
intro: Mythgate 5e Companion is an independent app, compatible with the fifth edition ("5E compatible"). This page collects the license notices used for rules-reference content.

srd.title: SRD 5.1 (Creative Commons)
srd.body: Rules-reference content (races, classes, conditions, equipment, etc.) is derived from the System Reference Document 5.1 and used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC-BY-4.0). The app uses neutral 5e terminology.

trademarks.title: Trademarks
trademarks.body: Mythgate 5e Companion is not an official Wizards of the Coast product and does not use their trademarks, product names, or logos as app branding.
